December 2024


                                               
                                               


                                               


Minerva's Regular Decision I Deadline is January 7


                                Are you excited about the opportunity to live in global cities across four continents, gaining essential skills for the future while learning alongside students from over 100 countries and territories? Take the next step toward joining Minerva University and complete your application before the Regular Decision I deadline on January 7.                              



Begin Your Application <https://www.minerva.edu/application/1/?utm_campaign=CommuniqueDec24&utm_content=ug-communique&utm_medium=email&utm_source=email-marketing&utm_term=Dec2024>

 




Events




                                               
Discover Life as a Minerva Student at Our Virtual Open House


                                Join Minerva's Virtual Open House on Saturday, January 11 at 6 am Pacific Time and meet our faculty, admissions officers, and current students. From learning about Minerva's applied academics to our global immersion in some of the world's most dynamic cities, you will receive a real taste of life at Minerva and get one step closer to discovering your dream university.                              



Register Here <https://www.minerva.edu/meridians/?utm_campaign=CommuniqueDec24&utm_content=ug-communique&utm_medium=email&utm_source=email-marketing&utm_term=Dec2024>

 




Community




                                               


Minerva Wrapped: Celebrating 12 Years of Accomplishments


                                From groundbreaking student achievements to inspiring community milestones, join us in looking back at some of the highlights that have shaped Minerva over the past 12 years.                               



Learn More <https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/64ca995f0fd30a33b2fd01cc/676463b69457ad871ecdca50_Minerva%20University%20Wrapped.pdf?utm_campaign=CommuniqueDec24&utm_content=ug-communique&utm_medium=email&utm_source=email-marketing&utm_term=Dec2024>



 




Updates




                                               


Eight Minerva University Students Named as Millennium Fellows


                                Congratulations to our eight Minerva University students who have been selected to join this year's prestigious Millennium Fellowship! This global initiative provides an opportunity to further the UN's Sustainable Development Goals through students designing and leading their own impactful projects.                              





 




Awards




                                               
Jiayuan Tian, Class of 2025, Receives Prestigious Diana Award


                                Jiayuan Tian, Class of 2025, has become Minerva's second Diana Award recipient and the only honoree from mainland China this year, recognized for his work advancing educational equity through initiatives like OneXplore and the Tilting Futures Chinese Media Center. His efforts have reached over 100,000 students, breaking barriers to international education and inspiring young people in Chinese-speaking communities to explore global opportunities.

What is changing
----------------

First, let's address the elephant in the room: CodeSandbox will continue to run as normal. We will keep working on CodeSandbox, and you can continue using sandboxes and devboxes for your projects.

CodeSandbox SDK

import json

class BerryField:
    def __init__(self, grid):
        self.grid = grid

    def __str__(self):
        result = ""
        for row in self.grid:
            result += " ".join(f"{:>4}".format(cell) for cell in row) + "\n"
        return result

    def grow(self):
        for i in range(len(self.grid)):
            for j in range(len(self.grid[i])):
                if 1 <= self.grid[i][j] < 10:
                    self.grid[i][j] += 1

    def spread(self):
        new_grid = [row[:] for row in self.grid]
        for i in range(len(self.grid)):
            for j in range(len(self.grid[i])):
                if self.grid[i][j] == 10:
                    for di, dj in [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]:
                        ni, nj = i + di, j + dj
                        if 0 <= ni < len(self.grid) and 0 <= nj <
len(self.grid[i]) and self.grid[ni][nj] == 0:
                            new_grid[ni][nj] = 1
        self.grid = new_grid

    def count_berries(self):
        return sum(sum(cell for cell in row if isinstance(cell, int)) for
row in self.grid)

class BerryField:
    def __init__(self, grid):
        self.grid = grid

    def __str__(self):
        result = ""
        for row in self.grid:
            result += " ".join(f"{:>4}".format(cell) for cell in row) + "\n"
        return result

    def grow(self):
        for i in range(len(self.grid)):
            for j in range(len(self.grid[i])):
                if 1 <= self.grid[i][j] < 10:
                    self.grid[i][j] += 1

    def spread(self):
        new_grid = [row[:] for row in self.grid]
        for i in range(len(self.grid)):
            for j in range(len(self.grid[i])):
                if self.grid[i][j] == 10:
                    for di, dj in [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]:
                        ni, nj = i + di, j + dj
                        if 0 <= ni < len(self.grid) and 0 <= nj <
len(self.grid[i]) and self.grid[ni][nj] == 0:
                            new_grid[ni][nj] = 1
        self.grid = new_grid

class Bear:
    def __init__(self, row, col, direction):
        self.row = row
        self.col = col
        self.direction = direction
        self.asleep_turns = 0
        self.berries_eaten = 0

    def __str__(self):
        state = "Asleep" if self.asleep_turns > 0 else "Awake"
        return f"Bear at ({self.row}, {self.col}) moving {self.direction}
({state})"

    def move(self):
        if self.asleep_turns > 0:
            self.asleep_turns -= 1
            return

        directions = {
            "N": (-1, 0), "S": (1, 0), "E": (0, 1), "W": (0, -1),
            "NE": (-1, 1), "NW": (-1, -1), "SE": (1, 1), "SW": (1, -1)
        }
        if self.direction in directions:
            di, dj = directions[self.direction]
            self.row += di
            self.col += dj

    def eat(self, berry_field):
        if self.row < 0 or self.row >= len(berry_field.grid) or self.col <
0 or self.col >= len(berry_field.grid[0]):
            return

        if berry_field.grid[self.row][self.col] > 0:
            self.berries_eaten += berry_field.grid[self.row][self.col]
            berry_field.grid[self.row][self.col] = 0

class Tourist:
    def __init__(self, row, col):
        self.row = row
        self.col = col
        self.turns_without_bear = 0

    def __str__(self):
        return f"Tourist at ({self.row}, {self.col}),
{self.turns_without_bear} turns without seeing a bear"

    def observe(self, bears):
        nearby_bears = 0
        for bear in bears:
            if abs(bear.row - self.row) <= 4 and abs(bear.col - self.col)
<= 4:
                nearby_bears += 1
        if nearby_bears == 0:
            self.turns_without_bear += 1
        else:
            self.turns_without_bear = 0
        return nearby_bears

# Load data from JSON file
def main():
    file_name = input("Enter the name of the JSON file: ")
    with open(file_name, 'r') as f:
        data = json.load(f)

    # Create the BerryField
    berry_field = BerryField(data["berry_field"])

    # Create active bears
    active_bears = [Bear(row, col, direction) for row, col, direction in
data["active_bears"]]
    reserve_bears = [Bear(row, col, direction) for row, col, direction in
data["reserve_bears"]]

    # Create active tourists
    active_tourists = [Tourist(row, col) for row, col in
data["active_tourists"]]
    reserve_tourists = [Tourist(row, col) for row, col in
data["reserve_tourists"]]

    # Print initial state
    print("Initial Berry Field:")
    print(berry_field)

    print("\nActive Bears:")
    for bear in active_bears:
        print(bear)

    print("\nActive Tourists:")
    for tourist in active_tourists:
        print(tourist)

    # Simulate until no bears and no berries
    turn = 0
    while active_bears or reserve_bears or any(any(cell > 0 for cell in
row) for row in berry_field.grid):
        turn += 1
        print(f"\nTurn {turn}")

        # Grow and spread berries
        berry_field.grow()
        berry_field.spread()

        # Move bears and eat berries
        for bear in active_bears[:]:
            bear.eat(berry_field)
            bear.move()
            if bear.row < 0 or bear.row >= len(berry_field.grid) or
bear.col < 0 or bear.col >= len(berry_field.grid[0]):
                active_bears.remove(bear)

        # Check tourists
        for tourist in active_tourists[:]:
            nearby_bears = tourist.observe(active_bears)
            if nearby_bears >= 3 or tourist.turns_without_bear >= 3:
                active_tourists.remove(tourist)

        # Add reserve bears and tourists
        if reserve_bears and sum(sum(row) for row in berry_field.grid) >=
500:
            active_bears.append(reserve_bears.pop(0))
        if reserve_tourists and active_bears:
            active_tourists.append(reserve_tourists.pop(0))

        # Print state every 5 turns
        if turn % 5 == 0 or (not active_bears and not reserve_bears and not
any(any(cell > 0 for cell in row) for row in berry_field.grid)):
            print("Berry Field:")
            print(berry_field)

            print("\nActive Bears:")
            for bear in active_bears:
                print(bear)

            print("\nActive Tourists:")
            for tourist in active_tourists:
                print(tourist)

subject: Reminder: Keep your Timeline data? Decide soon
body:
Hi mo,
You have Timeline turned on for your account, which helps you go back in
time and remember where you've been. With Timeline, your visits and routes
are automatically saved to a map on each of your devices.
This is a reminder that Timeline is changing
<https://support.google.com/maps?p=maps_odlh>. Now, if you're signed in on
multiple smartphones, each device will save new visits on its own Timeline.
Because of these changes, you need to choose new settings to avoid losing
Timeline data.
What you need to do
*If you’d like to keep your saved visits and routes,* choose your settings
<https://www.google.com/maps/timeline?ved=0EPO3DAgAKAA&pb=!1m3!1m2!3b1!4e4&gid=101747861382977483734>
on your preferred smartphone by *December 8, 2024*. (You may first need to
update the Google Maps app.) Learn more about how to keep your Timeline
data. <https://support.google.com/maps/answer/14169818>
After you do this, you’ll only be able to use Timeline in the app.
*If you take no action, you may lose data.* Google will try moving up to 90
days of Timeline data to the first signed-in device you use after
*December 8, 2024*. Your older data will be deleted. Timeline will also
remain on for your account, and your devices will continue saving new
visits. Your visits and routes older than 3 months will be auto-deleted.
Review & choose settings
<https://www.google.com/maps/timeline?ved=0EPG3DAgAKAA&pb=!1m3!1m2!3b1!4e4&gid=101747861382977483734>

Tips to protect yourself from impersonation scams
Scammers posing as various organizations like Amazon may send you calls, texts, and emails with various tactics to try to deceive you to provide personal information or sign-in credentials. What to watch out for? Scammers may tell you there is a fraud investigation and you must “verify” your account or claim there is an unauthorized or fraudulent activity on your Amazon account. How can you avoid being scammed? * Amazon will never ask you to share your password, account sign-in One-Time Password (OTP), or verify sensitive personal information over the phone. * Visit the [Message Center](https://www.amazon.com/messages) on Amazon.com or on our app to review authentic emails from Amazon. * Go directly to our website, and go to [Your Account](https://www.amazon.com/youraccount) to make changes to your billing and account information. * Customer Service is available 24/7 to help with any questions you may have. Keep others safe If you receive communication — a call, text, or email — that you think may not be from Amazon, please report it to us at, [ amazon.com/reportascam](https://www.amazon.com/reportascam). For more information on how to stay safe online, visit [Protect Your System](https://www.amazon.com/ProtectYourSystem) on the Amazon Customer Service page.

subject: Reminder: Keep your Timeline data? Decide soon
body:
Hi mo,
You have Timeline turned on for your account, which helps you go back in
time and remember where you've been. With Timeline, your visits and routes
are automatically saved to a map on each of your devices.
This is a reminder that Timeline is changing
<https://support.corp.google.com/maps?p=maps_odlh>. Now, if you're signed
in on multiple smartphones, each device will save new visits on its own
Timeline. Because of these changes, you need to choose new settings to
avoid losing Timeline data.
What you need to do
*If you’d like to keep your saved visits and routes,* choose your settings
<https://www.google.com/maps/timeline?ved=0EPO3DAgAKAA&pb=!1m3!1m2!3b1!4e4&gid=101747861382977483734>
on your preferred smartphone by *December 8, 2024*. (You may first need to
update the Google Maps app.) Learn more about how to keep your Timeline
data. <https://support.google.com/maps/answer/14169818>
After you do this, you’ll only be able to use Timeline in the app.
*If you take no action, you may lose data.* Google will try moving up to 90
days of Timeline data to the first signed-in device you use after
*December 8, 2024*. Your older data will be deleted. Timeline will also
remain on for your account, and your devices will continue saving new
visits. Your visits and routes older than 3 months will be auto-deleted.
Review & choose settings
<https://www.google.com/maps/timeline?ved=0EPG3DAgAKAA&pb=!1m3!1m2!3b1!4e4&gid=101747861382977483734>
If you don’t want any Timelines on your devices, you can turn off this
setting and delete your data in Activity controls
<https://accounts.google.com/AccountChooser?continue=https://myaccount.google.com/activitycontrols/location&Email=skk126skk126@gmail.com>.

Your Timeline data
3
Countries/​Regions
<https://www.google.com/maps/timeline?ved=0EMy7CQgAKAA&pb=!1m2!5m1!3m0&gid=101747861382977483734>
92
Cities
<https://www.google.com/maps/timeline?ved=0EMu7CQgAKAA&pb=!1m2!5m1!2m0&gid=101747861382977483734>
446
Places
<https://www.google.com/maps/timeline?ved=0EM27CQgAKAA&pb=!1m2!5m1!1m0&gid=101747861382977483734>  
Go
to your Timeline
<https://www.google.com/maps/timeline?ved=0EPS3DAgAKAA&pb=!1m3!1m2!3b1!4e4&gid=101747861382977483734>
About Timeline
Timeline helps you go back in time, and remember where you've been, by
automatically saving your visits and routes to a map on each of your
devices. To learn more about Timeline, visit the Help Center
<https://support.google.com/maps/answer/6258979>.
You received this email to let you know about important changes to your
Google Account and services.

In honor of Founders Day and our Bicentennial, RPI will host its annual fall giving day, 24 for 1824.  ##SENDGRIDOPENTRACKING##

In honor of Founders Day and our Bicentennial, RPI will host its annual fall giving day,  https://givingday.rpi.edu/ . This day of giving is an opportunity to support our students, the next generation of RPI alumni. 

Founders Day is recognized each year on November 5 – the date a letter was written by Stephen Van Rensselaer announcing the formation of the Rensselaer School, where he declared his intent to educate students “in the application of science to the common purposes of life.” 

With that letter, the school that we know as Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute began.  As we celebrate 200 years of history for RPI, you can help honor RPI’s rich past, enduring legacy, and groundbreaking impact on society by joining us for our 24-hour day of giving back in support of RPI students.  Gifts in support of students are a direct connection to Rensselaer’s past, present, and future. 
On  https://givingday.rpi.edu/ , we will recognize this moment in RPI history by hosting a 24-hour giving day in support of the Rensselaer Annual Fund.  To attract and retain the smartest and most promising candidates, RPI must have the financial resources to compete with other top-tier universities, including those able to meet the full financial need of students. 

The day kicks off on November 12, 2024 at 12 a.m., and will go through midnight EST. 
  
For the most up-to-date information,  https://givingday.rpi.edu/ , follow us on social media, and check your inbox for more details. We hope you join us for this special event!

( https://links.blizzard.com/f/a/ovVGvNt5LgLxNBFi4fadxw~~/AAQRxQA~/RgRpBOuYP0TOaHR0cHM6Ly91cy5zaG9wLmJhdHRsZS5uZXQvZW4tdXMvcHJvZHVjdC93b3JsZC1vZi13YXJjcmFmdC1zdWJzY3JpcHRpb24_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT13b3ctd2VsY29tZS1qb3VybmV5LXdlbGNvbWUmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWFya2V0aW5nLW5hLTImdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9dGV4dC13b3ctc3Vic2NyaXB0aW9uJmxpZD11cmtwemtqYmw3MzNXA3NwY0IKZxKYZiJn4UFXOVIWc2trMTI2c2trMTI2QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAABYQ~~ )

of Discovery, and challenging Classic Hardcore realms. Each month
of your subscription you’ll also get a complimentary 500 Trader’s
Tender² to spend on eye-catching collectibles offered at the
Trading Post in World of
Warcraft.

time you log in, the game will recommend a realm (game server) 
( https://links.blizzard.com/f/a/8vs54q44jP3ccZQPu_A7gQ~~/AAQRxQA~/RgRpBOuYP0S8aHR0cHM6Ly91cy5iYXR0bGUubmV0L3N1cHBvcnQvZW4vYXJ0aWNsZS8yODYzNzQ_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT13b3ctd2VsY29tZS1qb3VybmV5LXdlbGNvbWUmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWFya2V0aW5nLW5hLTImdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9dGV4dC1saW5rLXJlYWxtLWdhbWUtc2VydmVyJmxpZD1kdnIxZHBmaTh2N3RXA3NwY0IKZxKYZiJn4UFXOVIWc2trMTI2c2trMTI2QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAABYQ~~ )

play on, you may wish to select that one instead. Not sure which
realm to choose? Don't worry—you can always start a new character
on another realm at any

HOW TO CREATE YOUR
CHARACTER
(
https://links.blizzard.com/f/a/SCYKENiZHPW6dtL6A2q58w~~/AAQRxQA~/RgRpBOuYP0S0aHR0cHM6Ly93b3JsZG9md2FyY3JhZnQuY29tL2VuLXVzL2dhbWUvcmFjZXM_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT13b3ctd2VsY29tZS1qb3VybmV5LXdlbGNvbWUmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWFya2V0aW5nLW5hLTImdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9aW1hZ2UtbGluay1ob3ctdG8tY3JlYXRlLXlvdXItY2hhcmFjdGVyVwNzcGNCCmcSmGYiZ-FBVzlSFnNrazEyNnNrazEyNkBnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAWE~

YOUR
CHARACTER
(
https://links.blizzard.com/f/a/M1unpyVe6JMGeOX8iF4TfQ~~/AAQRxQA~/RgRpBOuYP0S4aHR0cHM6Ly93b3JsZG9md2FyY3JhZnQuY29tL2VuLXVzL2dhbWUvcmFjZXM_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT13b3ctd2VsY29tZS1qb3VybmV5LXdlbGNvbWUmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWFya2V0aW5nLW5hLTImdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9c3ViaGVhZGVyLWxpbmstaG93LXRvLWNyZWF0ZS15b3VyLWNoYXJhY3RlclcDc3BjQgpnEphmImfhQVc5UhZza2sxMjZza2sxMjZAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAFh
)                 There are
many important decisions ahead that will shape how you play World
of Warcraft, but let's begin with these two: race and class. Race

( https://links.blizzard.com/f/a/XOaEJiY7U0zCJcejK4Gl7Q~~/AAQRxQA~/RgRpBOuYP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly93b3JsZG9md2FyY3JhZnQuY29tL2VuLXVzL2dhbWUvcmFjZXM_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT13b3ctd2VsY29tZS1qb3VybmV5LXdlbGNvbWUmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWFya2V0aW5nLW5hLTImdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9dGV4dC1saW5rLXJhY2UmbGlkPTZ0ZTJham56bHZjcFcDc3BjQgpnEphmImfhQVc5UhZza2sxMjZza2sxMjZAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAFh )
 determines overall look and which faction you are aligned with,
Alliance or Horde. Class 
( https://links.blizzard.com/f/a/KKQjTLhzmLHO1f8gzSoJMA~~/AAQRxQA~/RgRpBOuYP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly93b3JsZG9md2FyY3JhZnQuY29tL2VuLXVzL2dhbWUvY2xhc3Nlcz91dG1fc291cmNlPXdvdy13ZWxjb21lLWpvdXJuZXktd2VsY29tZSZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1tYXJrZXRpbmctbmEtMiZ1dG1fY29udGVudD10ZXh0LWxpbmstY2xhc3NlcyZsaWQ9dDFjbGZhaXN2NGdqVwNzcGNCCmcSmGYiZ-FBVzlSFnNrazEyNnNrazEyNkBnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAWE~ )
 determines how you play the game. Each class has different
abilities and play styles, including dealing damage from close or
long range, protecting allies, and healing wounds.

Do note, you can create multiple characters. Feel free to try
multiple race and class combinations to learn what feels best for
you!
FACTIONS &
RACES
(
https://links.blizzard.com/f/a/ZXIwD6kbbNs3Phs81fsdtw~~/AAQRxQA~/RgRpBOuYP0SqaHR0cHM6Ly93b3JsZG9md2FyY3JhZnQuY29tL2VuLXVzL2dhbWUvcmFjZXM_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT13b3ctd2VsY29tZS1qb3VybmV5LXdlbGNvbWUmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWFya2V0aW5nLW5hLTImdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9aW1hZ2UtbGluay1mYWN0aW9ucy1hbmQtcmFjZXNXA3NwY0IKZxKYZiJn4UFXOVIWc2trMTI2c2trMTI2QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAABYQ~~
)                 FACTIONS &
RACES
(
https://links.blizzard.com/f/a/32mCUI5-4tiNaxFXM9R1Ug~~/AAQRxQA~/RgRpBOuYP0SuaHR0cHM6Ly93b3JsZG9md2FyY3JhZnQuY29tL2VuLXVzL2dhbWUvcmFjZXM_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT13b3ctd2VsY29tZS1qb3VybmV5LXdlbGNvbWUmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWFya2V0aW5nLW5hLTImdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9c3ViaGVhZGVyLWxpbmstZmFjdGlvbnMtYW5kLXJhY2VzVwNzcGNCCmcSmGYiZ-FBVzlSFnNrazEyNnNrazEyNkBnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAWE~
)                 Two factions
fight for control of Azeroth, each made up of multiple races
bound by a shared purpose. Driven by a sense of justice and a
desire to illuminate the darkest corners of the world, the
Alliance seeks to bring order to Azeroth's war-torn lands and
emphasize honor and tradition above all else.

A coalition of outcasts who have forged a union in the flames of
survival, the Horde values action and strength, committed to

October news from the Minerva Community

                                               
A MINERVA PUBLICATION



 


October 2024


                                               
                                               


                                               


                              Minerva's Early Action Deadline is November 1                            


                                What problem are you passionate about solving? Minerva University is for the ethical, purposeful, and bold individuals looking to join a global community of emerging leaders, problem-solvers, and entrepreneurs. If you are eager to turn your passion into impact, Minerva may be the right place for you. Apply by November 1 for our Early Action deadline and take the first step toward a transformative college experience.                              



Begin Your Application <https://www.minerva.edu/application/1/?utm_campaign=CommuniqueOct24&utm_content=ug-communique&utm_medium=email&utm_source=email-marketing&utm_term=Oct2024>

 




Events




                                               
                              Watch Recordings from Minerva's Virtual Open House                            


                                Minerva's Virtual Open House gave prospective undergraduate students an in-depth look at our unique approach to education. The event featured sessions on student life, applied learning, and admissions, giving attendees the chance to hear from students, alumni, and faculty while exploring Minerva's unique global education model.                              



Watch the Recordings <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WZRUe0Z7Snc&list=PL-V70w67FyfKxvus8U58xRNsm1IH33vbj&ab_channel=MinervaUniversity&utm_campaign=CommuniqueOct24&utm_content=ug-communique&utm_medium=email&utm_source=email-marketing&utm_term=Oct2024>

 




Admissions




                                               


                              How to Best Present Your Accomplishments                            


                                Minerva seeks students who demonstrate leadership and proactive engagement. The Accomplishments section allows applicants to showcase their diverse achievements, such as work experience, creative pursuits, or overcoming challenges. Learn how to best present your unique achievements in this new blog post.                              



Read More <https://www.minerva.edu/blog/application-advice---how-to-best-present-your-accomplishments/?utm_campaign=CommuniqueOct24&utm_content=ug-communique&utm_medium=email&utm_source=email-marketing&utm_term=Oct2024>



 




Community




                                               


                              The Chen Siblings' Journey to Minerva                            


                                Siblings Benjamin (Class of 2020), Anais (Class of 2023), and Bentley Chen (Class of 2024) each found their unique paths to Minerva University. Despite starting at traditional institutions, they were drawn to Minerva's innovative approach to learning and the opportunity to connect with a tight-knit global community. Minerva became not just a university, but a family tradition.                              



Read Their Story <https://www.instagram.com/p/DArLUTxz-2x/?utm_campaign=CommuniqueOct24&utm_content=ug-communique&utm_medium=email&utm_source=email-marketing&utm_term=Oct2024>



 




Student Initiatives




                                               
                              Google Developer Group Minerva                            


                                Learn about Minerva University's Google Developer Group (GDG), a student initiative founded by Ifeoluwakolopin Are, Class of 2025, to support students passionate about technology. With a focus on hands-on learning, collaboration, and growth, GDG Minerva offers coding workshops, virtual labs, and project showcases, helping students of all technical levels connect, learn, and apply their skills to real-world challenges.                              



Learn More <https://www.minerva.edu/blog/student-initiative---google-developer-group-minerva/?utm_campaign=CommuniqueOct24&utm_content=ug-communique&utm_medium=email&utm_source=email-marketing&utm_term=Oct2024>

‌Rh factor‌

Rh factor (or Rhesus factor) is a protein inherited from your biological parents found on the surface of red blood cells. If you have this protein, you’re Rh-positive. A Flexible Spending Account (FSA) or Health Savings Account (HSA) helps you save money by setting aside funds before taxes to pay for qualified medical expenses.**


But, what’s the difference between the 2 accounts?


A Flexible Spending Account (FSA) is owned by your employer, so if you switch jobs you’ll lose the funds you haven’t spent. Plus, they may expire at the end of each year.



A Health Savings Account (HSA) is only available with a High-Deductible Health Plan. The funds roll over each year and there is no time limit on when you can spend the money.

You are receiving this email because we do not have your Social Security number (SSN) on file, which is required to complete the form on your behalf.

    To comply with this statute, please complete Form W-9S, 'Request for Student's or Borrower's Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification' (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/fw9s.pdf) and return it no later than January 10, 2025.  You only need to complete Part I of the form.   

    Your SSN will only be used for the purpose of preparing form 1098-T.  All documentation and communication prepared by UCM will use your Student ID number.  For this reason, please write your UCM ID number on the W-9S form before submitting it Student Financial Services, PO Box 800/WDE 1100, Warrensburg, MO  64093.

Keep your Timeline? Decide by December 8, 2024
body:
Hi mo,
You previously turned on the Timeline setting—formerly called Location
History —which helps you go back in time and remember where you’ve been.
With Timeline, your visits and routes are automatically saved to a map on
each of your devices.
Timeline is changing and will now be created on your device. As part of
this, you'll need to choose settings for your data
<https://www.google.com/maps/timeline?ved=0EPK3DAgAKAA&pb=!1m3!1m2!3b1!4e4&gid=101747861382977483734>  
*by
December 8, 2024* to avoid losing visits and routes.
How it works
Like before, your devices will continue to save your visits in Timeline
when this setting is on. But now, if you're signed in on multiple
smartphones, each device will save new visits on its own Timeline.
What you need to do
*If you’d like to keep your saved visits and routes,* choose your settings
<https://www.google.com/maps/timeline?ved=0EPO3DAgAKAA&pb=!1m3!1m2!3b1!4e4&gid=101747861382977483734>
on your preferred smartphone by *December 8, 2024*. (You may first need to
update the Google Maps app.) Learn more about how to keep your Timeline

• 사용자약관 업데이트는 2024년 11월 20일에 적용되며 콘텐츠 추천, 콘텐츠 수정 관행, 생성형 AI 기능 관련 신규 조항, 크리에이터가 LinkedIn 외부로 브랜드를 확장하도록 설계된 라이선스 업데이트에 대한 자세한 정보를 포함합니다.
• LinkedIn 제품이 생성형 AI를 활용하도록 혁신되고 있으므로 LinkedIn 및 제휴사가 콘텐츠 생성에 사용하는 AI 모델을 훈련(“생성형 AI”)하고 보안 및 안전 조치를 통해 회원님이 제공하신 정보를 어떻게 사용하는지에 대한 설명을 추가하여 개인정보 처리방침의 추가 정보를 알려드렸습니다.
• 현재 유럽경제지역, 스위스, 영국 거주 회원 데이터를 생성형 AI 훈련에 사용할 수 없습니다. 해당 지역 외부에 거주하는 이 목적으로 정보를 사용하지 않도록 선택하신 회원에 대해 우선적으로 해지 설정(https://www.linkedin.com/e/v2?urlhash=KBj9&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Elinkedin%2Ecom%2Fmypreferences%2Fd%2Fsettings%2Fdata-for-ai-improvement&lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_comms_adhoc_2024_legal_tos_update%3B2WJA8llCRWKVfbtHOs2lMw%3D%3D&midToken=AQGATbCF-8UPdw&midSig=1Ctl6k1c5zFHs1&ek=email_comms_adhoc_2024_legal_tos_update&e=dex876-m26f5obq-vr&eid=dex876-m26f5obq-vr&m=email_body&ts=eml-comm_adhoc-b-tos_opt_out_setting&li=0&t=plh)을 사용하실 수 있도록 했습니다.

    Mansion buildings have had a design revamp (although this was accidentally released early a couple of weeks ago :D)
